# CharterFolk

> CharterFolk is a WordPress-powered platform providing user authentication and account management services.

CharterFolk leverages WordPress and Jetpack technologies to deliver secure user login and single sign-on capabilities. The platform focuses on streamlined account access and authentication for its user community.

## Key Topics

- WordPress
- User Authentication
- Login
- SSO (Single Sign-On)
- Account Access
- Jetpack
- WordPress.com
- User Account Management

## User Authentication

- [Log In](https://www.charterfolk.org/wp-login.php): WordPress login page for CharterFolk user authentication and account access
